We saw the 5xx at 2027-06-29T22:47:12Z and again ~22:52:07Z. Both failures were 502 gateway responses with an upstream error logged as "timeout reading response" on our edge proxy.

Notes from our infra team:
- Calls are authenticated using a short-lived OAuth token that we exchange via our STS flow.
- We do route traffic through an API gateway that rewrites the Host header; sometimes we see non-deterministic routing to a fallback model variant during bursts.

We'd like to get an action item list for the POC and confirmation you can reproduce on your side. Happy to hop on a quick debugging session tomorrow if that helps.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Solstice integration — auth/routing repro + next steps

Hi all — quick update from the reproduction effort. I followed the steps Rachel outlined this afternoon against our staging routing policy. Summary: 

- Single-run (sequential) with their repro_payload.json: all succeeded (200).
- 5 sequential runs: 1 of 5 returned a 502 at 2027-06-30T15:22:31-07:00. Captured Redwood request_id: rwd-0a1b2c3d; model_variant: reranker-v3-quant; timings: gateway 18ms / runtime 520ms / model_infer 480ms. Upstream note in runtime: "kvcache-lock-wait 300ms".
- 20 concurrent burst: 3 of 20 returned 502s — request_ids rwd-0a1b2c3e, rwd-0a1b2c3f, rwd-0a1b2c40. Pattern suggests contention on KV cache lock and an internal retry path that switched to a fallback variant causing slower execution and TTL expiration in the gateway.

What I recommend: 
1) For the POC, pin routing to a single stable model_variant (reranker-v3-quant) to avoid fallback churn while we characterize burst behavior.
2) Increase our internal KV cache lock timeout slightly and add backoff jitter to our retry path — I'll prototype a small change and run a synthetic load test.
3) Ask Solstice to use a 90s client timeout for the POC (they currently have 60s) to tolerate occasional slow tails while we tune.

I'll attach the raw traces to the debug folder in Drive and can run a joint session tomorrow at 9:30am PT to demo reproduction live. Marcus — if you can populate the MAP with these mitigations and timeline, we can send to procurement for approval.

Connor O'Brien
Support Engineer, Redwood Inference
